zh.02: 不会。站点原样按路径写进链上容器合约，没有 gzip / brotli / WebP 转换。所以「少传字节」是唯一的省钱手段。
zh.03: 默认安全档只改编码、不改路径、不改引用；压完跑 10 项校验，fail 会明确告诉你别发布；源目录全程只读，产物另存。
zh.04: 协议按「路径 + sha256」判断是否跳过。改了压缩参数，几乎每个文件的字节都变，会被当成全新内容整站重传。
zh.05: 这是协议行为：超限文件被静默跳过。我们会替你标出来，发布页不会。
zh.06: 路径段以 . 开头会被判为隐藏文件、静默跳过。所以在该协议下域名验证、ACME 都用不了。
zh.07: 现在不能自动压。字体子集化需要先有「码位覆盖」校验，否则会渲染成豆腐块；工具只报数（实测约还能省 88 KB）。
zh.08: 不会，也不签名。工具只出账单、产物和校验结论，发布仍走 TapeCode 界面。
zh.09: 算法是同一份代码，账单数字必然一致；差别在图片档位 —— 网页版走无损重压，服务器版走调色板量化，后者收益更大。
zh.10: BSC / X Layer / Base，计费公式相同，只有 gasPrice 地板价与币种不同。
zh.11: 网页版不需要注册、不需要 key；服务端 MCP 形态需要 API key，并且有体积 / 并发 / 超时限制。

en.02: No. Your site is written into the on-chain container contract path for path — no gzip, brotli or WebP conversion. Shipping fewer bytes is the only way to pay less.
en.03: The default safe preset only re-encodes: no path changes, no reference rewrites. Ten checks run afterwards, and a failure tells you plainly not to publish. Your source stays read-only; the output is written elsewhere.
en.04: The protocol skips files by path + sha256. Changing the shrink parameters changes the bytes of almost every file, which reads as brand-new content and re-uploads the whole site.
en.05: That's the protocol: files over the limit are silently skipped. We flag them for you; the publishing page won't.
en.06: Any path segment starting with a dot is treated as a hidden file and silently skipped — so domain verification and ACME can't be done under this protocol.
en.07: Not automatically, no. Font subsetting needs a code-point coverage check first, otherwise pages render as tofu boxes. The tool only reports the number (about 88 KB still on the table in our test).
en.08: No, and it doesn't sign anything either. It produces a bill, an output build and a verification verdict. Publishing still happens in the TapeCode UI.
en.09: Same algorithm, so the bill is identical by construction. The difference is image tiers: the web build re-encodes losslessly, the server build uses palette quantization, which saves more.
en.10: BSC, X Layer and Base. The gas formula is the same; only the floor price and the token differ.
en.11: The web build needs neither an account nor a key. The server MCP endpoint needs an API key and has size, concurrency and timeout limits.
